merge_basis: Study 1479-0012 (Beamion BCGC-1) covers Breast Cancer and Gastric Cancer cohorts under a single protocol; no existing group matches this study number or this specific BC/GC combined trial. G0012 covers Beamion Breast-2 (1479-0017) and G0015 covers Beamion Gastric-1 (1479-0013), both different study numbers and different indications. This is a distinct new topic.
